common_intent_requirements.text: 把一条柔软毛巾搭到椅背上
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把一条柔软毛巾搭到椅背上
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a single soft towel held in two hands. The hands lay the middle of the towel across the top of the chair back, leaving an end on each side.
Once the fabric rests on the chair, both hands open and withdraw completely.

common_intent_requirements.text: 让毛巾两头自然垂下来
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 让毛巾两头自然垂下来
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: The two loose ends drop downward under their own weight while the middle remains supported by the chair back.
Soft folds form and shift through the fabric, and a small settling sway gradually diminishes.

physics_checks.criterion: 柔软毛巾的形状与椅背支撑及重力方向相容。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 中部与椅背接触，两端在松手后向下垂落并产生自然褶皱。
fail_examples: 两端无支撑地水平悬在空中
松手后毛巾整体停在椅背上方
not_required: 不要求特定褶皱数量或两端等长
允许轻微摆动和接触面滑动

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
